title: Night Surf
reference_source: Максимальный гламурный регистр в рамках одетого кадра
mood_ru: Луна, прибой, мокрый песок. Промокшая футболка и холодная вода.
allure: wet-tee glamour, heavy soaked cotton clinging to her shape, long bare wet legs, sand on her skin, wild hair and a challenging look

wardrobe.notes_ru: Огромная мокрая футболка — плотный хлопок, непрозрачная — и низ бикини.
wardrobe.prompt: oversized soaked white cotton t-shirt, heavy opaque cotton clinging to her body, black bikini bottoms underneath, wet sandy legs, dripping wet hair, silver star pendant, barefoot

location.notes_ru: Пляж ночью, луна на прибое, пена, отражения на мокром песке.
location.prompt: dark empty beach at night, moonlight silvering the surf, foam running up the sand, mirror reflections on the wet sand, distant pier lights on the horizon, cool blue darkness

shots.pose: kneeling in the shallow surf as a wave breaks around her thighs, soaked tee clinging, both hands wringing the water out of her hair, chin lifted, looking up into the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at water level, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind rimming the wet fabric and hair, foam glowing white

shots.pose: lying back on the wet sand with foam running around her, one knee raised, both arms thrown above her head, wet tee and hair full of sand, eyes on the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, high three-quarter angle from above, full body framing
shots.light: moonlight straight down on her, mirror reflections in the wet sand around her

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the cold wet sand, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: standing close to the sheet of water on the wet sand, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: standing at the breaking surf line with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: reclining back on the cold wet sand propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of wet sand clinging to her shin and the dripping hem of the tee, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: lying on her back on the cold wet sand, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: standing tall ankle-deep in the running surf, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water

shots.pose: seen small across the space far down the empty moonlit beach, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: hard cold moonlight from behind her, rimming the wet fabric, warm distant pier lights glinting in the water
